name: koha-plugin-square-terminal
description: Square Terminal card-present payments plugin for Koha

scripts.preversion: sed -i -e "s/^our \$VERSION[[:space:]]*= .*/our \$VERSION         = \"$npm_new_version\";/" Koha/Plugin/Com/ByWaterSolutions/SquareTerminal.pm; sed -i -e "s/^version: .*/version: $npm_new_version/" Koha/Plugin/Com/ByWaterSolutions/SquareTerminal/PLUGIN.yml; perl scripts/stamp-changelog.pl v$npm_new_version; git add -u; rm -f Koha/Plugin/Com/ByWaterSolutions/SquareTerminal.pm-e Koha/Plugin/Com/ByWaterSolutions/SquareTerminal/PLUGIN.yml-e
scripts.postversion: perl scripts/open-next-changelog.pl v$npm_package_version; git add CHANGELOG.md; git commit -m 'Open next development cycle'

author: Laura Escamilla
